information: Welcome to Norwegian FMC Championship 2023! This special competition is held the weekend before the Norwegian Championship 2023, and the only event is fewest moves because this is the only event missing from Norwegian Championship 2023. By holding this competition the weekend before Norwegian Championship 2023, we have enough time to do three attempts (mean of 3) and declare a true Norwegian champion in the event. To include as many people as possible, the competition will be held in three different cities at the same time: Oslo, Trondheim and Sandnes.
